results.title: FAMILIAR
results.overview: A little girl and her mother look through an old photo album when a disturbing presence ruins the moment.

results.title: Toutes Directions
results.overview: When a 71-year-old regional taxi driver hears that he is losing his beloved job, he decides to take a different turn with his worn-out van full of regular passengers. The journey that follows, in which no passenger is left untouched, turns out to be exactly what he needs to start the rest of his life.

results.title: Mom's Blues
results.overview: A small provincial town. A young doctor's morning begins with an anxious knock at the window. A panicked woman reports that her child is dying. The doctor rushes to help and discovers signs of abuse on the child's body. An investigation begins, and the doctor is drawn into the dark depths of a family tragedy.

results.title: Doomed
results.overview: In search of who he really is, Omi uncovers a version of himself he was never meant to find, his Identity, it turns out, it can be its own kind of horror.

results.title: Family Go to the Bad House
results.original_title: Family Go to the Bad House
results.overview: Mother, Father and Child have just moved into their new home and are about to discover that the house is bad. A supercut of hundreds of horror films.

results.original_title: De Club van Sinterklaas film: Paniek in het Pietendorp

results.title: Offroad
results.overview: Set under the southern sun of the Canary Islands, three friends find themselves in over their heads in pursuit of freedom, dreams and a man named Francisco.  Maggie’s (Sofie Jo Kaufmanas) life looks perfect; she has a career, a home and a boyfriend, but inside she is slowly being suffocated by expectations and the weight of her own ambitions.  With her friends Eva (Julie Rudbæk) and Stine (Katinka Lærke Petersen), she sets out on a girls’ trip to Tenerife in search of freedom and dreams. But soon, one impulsive decision sends her and her two best friends on a reckless and chaotic journey across the island in a campervan.

results.title: Omeha
results.overview: Omega follows a special operations unit led by a commander known as The Artist. After missions behind enemy lines, humour, shared habits, and rituals become what hold them together,  allowing them to hold on to one another when returning from the very heart of hell. They are used to being seen as steel-clad “rexes”, and their operations are rarely spoken of out loud. But who is really hiding behind the masks?

results.title: Falling out of Love
results.overview: A short experimental animation depicting the continuous deformation and sequential metamorphosis of mechanical, industrial, and biological forms within a monochromatic space.

results.title: A Report for Minerva 2
results.overview: The lives of a mismatched group of guests and employees become entangled in a run-down hotel. Some have come in search of peace and a brief escape from their daily routine, while others long for change – or even love. A lonely clarinetist crosses paths with a young man looking for a romantic adventure, an unhappily married couple, an idiosyncratic hotel staff member, and also an alien sent from the planet Minerva 2 in order to report on the state of Earth. A mosaic of fourteen interwoven stories emerges through fleeting situations, awkward moments, interior monologues, and quiet observations. This experimental film by Miroslav Krobot and Lubomír Smékal is loosely based on the stage production of the same name by the S 23 Theatre Company, whose non-professional actors put together stage performances based on the dialogical acting method.

results.title: All Our Voices
results.overview: Cartagena de Indias, the walled city on Colombia’s Caribbean coast, isn’t the first place that comes to mind when you think of rock. But by the edge of the sea, an alternative music scene pulses with life. Bands move from punk to emo to post-punk to goth, while a community keeps alive the chance to be free from prejudice, the chance to be part of something unique.

results.title: Wreath
results.overview: Driven by their current principal's bureaucratic pressure, a group of teachers is forced to attend the funeral of a former headmaster they have never met. Lost and without a map, they embark on a journey toward a destination–and a man–that remains a complete mystery to them.

results.title: The Two Hornets
results.overview: Samo, a gay man facing an unplanned pregnancy with a woman overseas, reunites with his narcissistic mother at a remote forest cabin to confront their toxic past. Amidst a drug-fueled sexual affair with his former childhood bully, he struggles to decide if he should embrace fatherhood or break the cycle of inherited family sin. In Samo's warped reality, omnipresent hornets gain an evil power, forcing him to confront his mother with fire and an axe to extract the brutal truth of their relationship.

results.title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
results.original_title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
results.overview: YouTube star and musician Reza Arap takes the hot seat as top Indonesian comics roast his career, controversies and persona in this comedy special.

results.title: Kingpins
results.overview: Drowning in unpaid bills, an actress-slash-waitress hatches a plan to rob her workplace. When the heist goes wrong, she must give the performance of a lifetime to clear her name.

results.title: 12-Hour Shift
results.overview: An ordinary working day at a metallurgical plant — a place where clouds are born and rivers of fire flow; a place where everything feels like a dream turned into memory. Dedicated to the steelworkers of Azovstal.

results.title: Swimmers
results.overview: Marco is a timid teen who has yet to discover his own agency. Over his summer break, he signs up for a lifeguard training course, where he becomes entranced by his polar opposite, Xavier; a boy of mystery and unknown sexuality. Not wanting to risk making a fool of himself or stand out, Marco hides his feelings. When Marco is partnered up with Xavier for CPR and in-water drills, a connection begins to form. As Marco's confidence grows, so does their friendship. When it becomes clear Xavier may feel the same way, Marco must decide whether to act on his feelings or let his queer joy pass him by.

results.title: Half Light
results.overview: A man is given the opportunity for a fresh start by creating a clone of himself, but when he fails to follow the instructions properly things take a turn for the worst.
